newsitem.title: POLAND: Nomura gives Warta buy recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Nomura gives Warta buy recommendation.

text.p: Nomura Equity Research rated Polish insurance firm Warta SA shares as buy, pointing out the firm's growth potential in the developing Polish insurance market, Nomura said in its report dated August 29.
"As the second-largest insurer in Poland, where 38 million consumers are only just beginning to discover the benefits of insurance, Warta has exceptional growth potential," the report said.
Nomura saw Warta net earnings rising to 26.0 milllion zlotys this year and to 31 million next year, up from 1995 net of 13.7 million.
It said it expected the firm's gross premium to grow to 740 million zlotys in 1996 and to 888 million next year, up from last year's 654.8 million.
On Friday Warta traded at 50.5 zlotys.
